label: Twilio SMS notification connector
summary: Prepare consented SMS alert delivery through an explicitly scoped Twilio account and verified recipient policy.
core_boundary: An SMS destination is an external disclosure and spending boundary. Provider delivery events are not authentication, authorization or permission to replace essential local alerts. This is a design-only connector proposal. Essential hosting, current actor and tenant authorization, native service drivers and recovery remain in the free Core. No production interface, publisher trust, installation or effectful capability is established by this metadata.
acceptance: Qualify account/sender capabilities, verified recipient consent and per-tenant event, volume and spending limits without promising universal country or route availability.
Validate status-callback authenticity and event binding under the selected provider contract; prevent replay, duplicate sends and cross-tenant message disclosure.
Exercise throttling, revoked credentials, delayed/failed delivery and retries with redacted payloads; local Core recovery and baseline notifications remain usable.

Declare observation-only, import or externally managed ownership before any integration request. Refuse competing writers for Core-owned resources; ownership handoff requires an authorized inventory, admission review and recovery plan.

Before implementation, qualify an explicitly selected provider/interface revision, supported compatibility matrix, immutable package provenance, dependency inventory and licensing model; no release is admitted by this proposal.

Enforce current Core actor, tenant and capability checks at each admitted request; keep credentials in scoped secret references, redact diagnostics and reject arbitrary destinations, shell commands or host/container sockets.

Demonstrate that disablement, removal, provider outage and commercial entitlement loss preserve essential Core access, hosted workloads, local audit and recovery; retain owned data unless a separately authorized purge is requested.
